mei: Kicking off a config-only unpin for routing and batching. Change window 02:00-02:30 UTC. Canary plan 1% -> 8% -> 40% -> 100%. Watch p95, p99, and kvcache_free_pct.

deploy-bot: DeployBot started canary 8135792000 for cfg-micro-unpin-02. Stages scheduled: 1% (+6m) -> 8% (+12m) -> 40% (+20m) -> 100% (+30m). Quick smoke will run.

rahul: Summary of changes: per-tenant max_batch 12->8; routing timeout 1200->850ms; small geo weight shift eu-west +4%. Fallback: auto-fallback to quantized-v2 on tail spikes.

tessa: Abort rules: p95 > 1.4x baseline sustained 3m OR any pod OOM OR kvcache_free_pct < 60%. Rollback cmd: `rbctl rollback cfg-micro-unpin-02 && deploybot pin-route --route=global --model=v3`. I'll monitor.

deploy-bot: Canary at 1% (8135792022). Smoke: PASS. Metrics snapshot: p95 165ms (baseline 160), p99 410ms, kvcache_free_pct 82%. No OOMs.

mei: Proceed to 8%.

deploy-bot: Canary at 8% (8135792043). Snapshot: p95 170ms, p99 420ms, kvcache_free_pct 79%. No abort triggers.

deploy-bot: Canary complete 100% at 8135792065. Final metrics: p95 158ms, p99 405ms, kvcache_free_pct 81%. No aborts.

rahul: Release notes updated and pushed to internal docs. Post-deploy: monitor 2h for regressions, keep canary tag 24h, rollback snippet pinned. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
